title: Journey
subtitle: A unique voyage where each step is a renewal
explorerDescription: It all started with a passion for creativity and unique ideas. This first impulse led me on a path full of discoveries and learning. Like the axolotl, capable of regenerating and evolving while staying true to its essence, I strive to remain singular while constantly exploring new ideas.
timeline1_text: My journey began in London, where I pursued a DEUG in musicology as a guitarist. This experience was a springboard: it allowed me to play concerts, improve my musical skills through the study of various styles (classical, traditional, and contemporary) and collaborate with passionate artists.
timeline2_text: I explored rich cultures across different countries and continents, worked in multicultural environments, and held a variety of roles. These experiences broadened my worldview, strengthening my appreciation for cultural differences and their contribution to the creative field.
timeline3_text: For 15 years, I worked as a lighting technician after obtaining a degree in live performance techniques. I worked on various productions: theater, concerts, outdoor events, dance, and multimedia performances. I gained expertise in stage lighting, show management, and team coordination. This role also allowed me to collaborate with artists from diverse backgrounds, understand the needs of a performance, and anticipate logistical challenges. Precision, anticipation, and the ability to work under pressure became key skills, and my approach evolved from simple technical application to a true artistic vision, where lighting becomes a form of expression.
timeline4_text: Seeking renewal, I dived into the world of web design and full-stack development. Although this radical transition was a challenge, it has been incredibly enriching. I have learned to use design tools, code interactive websites, understand application architecture, and integrate user-friendly digital solutions. Involved in both personal and professional projects, I've experimented with web design, user experience, and programming. Today, my digital journey allows me to combine my passions for technology, art, and creativity, providing innovative solutions through digital platforms.
captain_description: Today, I sail as the captain of a ship in the waters of creativity. Every project is a unique exploration, guided by strong values such as listening, perseverance, and curiosity. I am here to transform your ideas into a custom reality, blending innovation and authenticity.
creative_solutions: Finding original solutions, tailored to each challenge.
understanding_needs: Understanding your needs to offer a personalized approach.
responding_to_demands: Responding to varied demands, in changing contexts.
transforming_obstacles: Turning every obstacle into an opportunity for renewal.
story_message: Your story could very well become the next step in my journey. Share your ideas, and let's see where it takes us!

category1.title: My First Clients
category1.content1: After completing my Boot Camp training at ' Le Reacteur ', I quickly realized that it wasn't enough to just create websites, but that I needed to stand out in order to attract my first clients.
category1.content2: Instead of following standard templates, I chose to design websites that capture the essence of each project and client, telling a unique visual story.
category1.content3: My first client came through word of mouth, and it was the perfect opportunity to put this personalized approach into practice, which would define my vision of design.

category2.title: Stand-Out Websites
category2.content1: In a world where many websites look alike, I choose to move away from standard templates to offer visually engaging sites.
category2.content2: I specialize in projects that highlight my clients' identities, whether they are artists, therapists, or entrepreneurs...
category2.content3: Each site becomes an opportunity to create something unique, reflecting the people who use it.
category2.content4: It’s this creative freedom and diversity that fuel my passion for custom and truly personalized design.

category3.title: A Matter of Ethics
category3.content1: Working as a freelancer is, above all, a choice guided by my values. I prioritize collaborations with independents, artists, associations, and entrepreneurs who share a vision of authenticity and creativity.
category3.content2: For me, each project is an opportunity to create bespoke websites that go beyond simple technical services, offering solutions that make sense and truly reflect the essence of those I work with.
category3.content3: My goal is not to produce in bulk, but to design websites that have soul, that carry a real story, and that meet the unique needs of each client.
